title: Moses served God faithfully for 40 years.
paragraphs: Moses served God faithfully for 40 years.

He confronted Pharaoh.
He parted the sea.
He carried Israel through the wilderness.
Yet he never stepped into the Promised Land.
One act of disobedience changed the outcome.

Faithful service is powerful…
but God’s holiness still matters.
The story raises a hard question:
Can great leaders still face consequences?
Before judging Moses, maybe the better question is:
Do we think obedience matters less once we've served a long time?
